Container.Name: Minecraft
Container.Overview:
This docker can run a Minecraft vanilla/bukkit/forge/neoforged/fabric/quilt(your choice) server on openjdk21 or 25(your choice).
UPDATE: This container can now auto update vanilla on restart if you leave the version blank.
Container.DonateText: Buy me a coffee if you like.
